step07.instructionPreference: How do you prefer to receive instructions?
step07.alert: This data generates the Functional Capacity Profile and filters exercises — for example, if you cannot bend your knees, fewer floor exercises will be prescribed.

step08.title: Habits
step08.subheading: Select only what you find relevant. This data helps the plan respect your reality.
step08.alert: This data feeds internal fatigue, adherence, and recovery predictions. Nothing is displayed directly to the trainer without authorization.

step09.title: Protected Sensitive Factors
step09.subtitle: Intimate data is protected. Appears to operational awareness. You can review and request human validation.
step09.alert: Medications, voluntarily declared substances, psychological history — stay private to you and are marked as 'declared safety factor' — conservative progression.
step09.medicationsSub: Optional — only if it affects energy, sleep, or performance.
step09.privacyNote: Private data. Never displayed to the trainer without explicit authorization.
step09.psychTitle: I want to declare emotional / psychiatric history

step09.substanceTitle: I want to declare recreational substance use
step09.substanceDesc: Anonymous. Influences intensity and monitoring recommendations.
step09.ruleText: Intimate data = private. Operational consequence = shared in masked form. You can revoke access at any time in Block 13.
step09.voiceNote: Speak freely — the AI structures it before saving.

step10.title: Body Rhythm
step10.subtitle: Private adaptation to physiological cycle, whenever you want to activate it. Never inspected.
step10.activateHint: This feature is opt-in. You can deactivate and delete data at any time.
step10.privacyNote: We never adopt things like "the student is on her period". Your operational adaptation will be: "Temporary biological factor — moderate approach and lower impact recommended".

intro.title: Coach DNA
intro.body: Capture your training signature so the AI Coach Engine generates workouts with your real method — not generic recommendations.
intro.privacyNote: The more accurate your profile, the more the generated workouts will sound like you wrote them.
intro.meta: ≈ 5–8 min · 12 blocks · powers the AI Coach Engine

step01.title: Trainer identity
step01.sub: Basic information that identifies your presence in the app.
step01.hint: How do you introduce yourself to your clients?

step02.title: Background & experience
step02.sub: How long you've been coaching and your academic / certification base.
step02.hint: Your experience shapes the depth of the workouts generated.
step02.privacyNote: Your background informs the AI Coach Engine about the technical depth of the protocols you use.

step03.title: Your current fitness level
step03.hint: Not your clients' — your own fitness level today.
step03.privacyNote: This calibrates the reference intensity of the workouts you prescribe, without exposing your personal information to clients.

step04.title: How and where you train
step04.sub: Methods, environments, and general intensity that define your practice.
step04.hint: Select everything that's part of your daily repertoire.
step04.privacyNote: Methods and environments guide the AI Coach Engine in selecting exercises and formats compatible with your context.

step05.title: Coaching style
step05.sub: How you show up with your clients in practice.
step05.hint: Choose all styles that describe your approach.
step05.privacyNote: Coaching style is the most decisive part of your DNA — it defines the tone and voice of every generated workout.

step06.title: Core principles
step06.sub: The beliefs that guide your prescription decisions.
step06.hint: What is your training philosophy at its core?
step06.privacyNote: The selected principles set absolute priorities in the generator — what appears first in every prescription.

step07.title: Training focus
step07.sub: How much weight does each physical capacity carry in your method?
step07.hint: Distribute emphasis across physical qualities. 0 = not a priority, 10 = central pillar.

step08.title: Exercises & repertoire
step08.sub: Your movement vocabulary defines your identity as a coach.
step08.hint: Add the exercises you use most and the ones you avoid. Press Enter or comma to confirm.
step08.privacyNote: This repertoire feeds the automatic exercise selection by the AI Coach Engine.

step09.title: Session design
step09.sub: The formats and intensity curve you prefer.
step09.hint: Choose the formats you use and the typical intensity curve of your sessions.

step10.title: Session structure
step10.sub: Define the default order of blocks in a typical session.
step10.hint: Reorder blocks using the arrows. This sequence will be the default template for your workouts.

step11.title: Audience & tone
step11.sub: Who you train and how you communicate.
step11.hint: Select all client profiles you work with and the predominant tone of your communication.

step12.title: Philosophy & identity
step12.sub: The manifesto that guides every workout you create.
step12.hint: This is the most personal block. Write or dictate in your own words.
step12.mottoPlaceholder: e.g. "Train with purpose, recover with intelligence."
step12.promptLabel: Free prompt — your coach voice for the AI
step12.promptPlaceholder: Describe in your own words how you train, what you value, and how you want the AI to represent your style when generating workouts...
step12.privacyNote: This prompt is the most powerful context in your DNA — the AI uses these words literally to capture your voice.

output.privacyNote: The archetype is derived automatically from your DNA and updates as you evolve your profile.

performance.title: Performance Coach
performance.desc: You train for results. Every session has metrics, every client has targets. Your DNA generates performance-oriented workouts focused on load progression and personal bests.

technician.title: The Technician
technician.desc: You are obsessed with method. Every exercise has a reason, every phase has logic. Your DNA generates workouts with precise technical cuing and well-structured progressions.

motivator.title: The Motivator
motivator.desc: You create environments that inspire. Your DNA generates workouts with energizing language, variety, and challenges that keep clients engaged and coming back.

guide.title: The Guide
guide.desc: You accompany each client at their own pace. Your DNA generates progressive workouts explained with empathy, focused on long-term health and client autonomy.

drill.title: Drill Master
drill.desc: You demand the best from every client. Your DNA generates challenging workouts with well-defined strength sequences and maximum execution standards in every rep.

movement.title: Movement Specialist
movement.desc: You see the body as an integrated system. Your DNA generates workouts emphasizing movement quality, mobility, and functional patterns.
